name: Alhóndiga (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and red, charged at the centre with the large crowned municipal arms of Alhóndiga (a cross of Malta and roundels).
history: Municipal flag of Alhóndiga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alhóndiga arms — cross of Malta and roundels
